rested.summary_en: Comfort level determines the duration of the Resting effect. Minimum duration is 8 minutes at 1 comfort, with each additional comfort level adding 1 minute, up to 29 minutes with usual items (31 minutes with both rare seasonal items). Max normally achievable comfort is 22 (23 near a Maypole/Yule tree, 24 with both). Only the highest-level item per category counts; items in the same category do not stack.
rested.summary_zh: 舒适度决定「休息好了」效果的持续时间。舒适度 1 时最短 8 分钟，每增加 1 级舒适度延长 1 分钟，常规物品最多 29 分钟（两种稀有季节性物品都有时为 31 分钟）。常规可达到的最高舒适度为 22（靠近仲夏柱 / 耶鲁树时为 23，两者都有时为 24）。每类家具只计最高等级的一件；同类物品不叠加。

food.summary_en: Food items provide temporary Health, Stamina and Eitr boosts. A player can consume up to three different types of food at any given time for a combined increase in buff strength. Buff strength decreases uniformly until the food is fully digested. A player cannot eat a second of the same food type until the previous one is at least partially digested (indicated by a flashing icon); eating the same type again refreshes strength and duration.
food.summary_zh: 食物提供临时的生命、体力与魔力加成。玩家最多可同时食用三种不同食物，加成效果叠加。加成强度会均匀下降，直到食物完全消化。同一种食物在上一份至少部分消化前（图标闪烁提示）不能再吃；再次食用同种食物会刷新强度与持续时间。

death.summary_en: Death occurs at 0 health. The player leaves a tombstone (gravestone) containing their equipment at the death location (map marked with skull-and-bones); no tombstone appears if the inventory was empty. Dying in deep water spawns a floating tombstone. Players respawn at the last bed slept in, or at the Sacrificial Stones if none. On death, the player loses 5% of total level in each skill (default World Modifier); the No skill drain effect (10 minutes) then prevents further loss from additional deaths. After collecting the gravestone, the player gains the Corpse run effect for 50 seconds.
death.summary_zh: 生命值归 0 即死亡。玩家会在死亡地点留下装有全部装备的墓碑（地图上以骷髅标记）；背包为空时不会出现墓碑。在深水中死亡会生成漂浮的墓碑。玩家在最后睡过的床复活，没有床则在献祭石复活。死亡时每项技能损失总等级的 5%（默认世界设置）；随后的「无技能损失」效果（10 分钟）可防止再次死亡时继续损失。取回墓碑后，玩家获得 50 秒的捡尸（Corpse run）效果。

_decisions.reason: 验收单原文把这一条写成「Ember Charge → 余烬(仓内 deep-north.md:6)」,但 deep-north.md 全文只把 Embers 译成「余烬」,从未给 Ember Charge 这个合成道具本身一个中文名(通篇写「Ember Charge / Ember Charges」);且 Ember Charge 自己的配方就吃 1 份 Embers,若把 Ember Charge 也命名成「余烬」,会在同一张配方表里出现「余烬」用「余烬」做的自我指代,读起来会误导。验收单紧接着那句「并把 Embers→余烬 的出处…改正为 deep-north.md:6」说的正是 Embers 这一条,判断前半句「Ember Charge →余烬」是笔误(写错了词条名,原意应为 Embers),按仓内实际译法处理为:只订正 Embers 词条的出处,Ember Charge 本身保留英文原名不译。
_decisions.status: 如果站主确认原意就是要把 Ember Charge 这个道具本身也译成「余烬」,请明确给一个不与 Embers 冲突的译名(比如「余烬弹」之类),再由实现者补上 name_zh 与 zh_glossary_sources。
